actual.titulo: Royals: Keeping the Crown • Post-War Amnesia
actual.descripcion: Post-War Amnesia ║ World War II may be over, but it still casts a long shadow over royal families, particularly those with links to fascism; in Britain, King George VI works to keep his brother's closeness to the Nazis away from the British people.
